title: Veggie Burgers
notes: These patties aren't just good for vegetarians, they go really well with bacon!

ingredientSections.heading: Veggie Burgers
items: 1 Cup Pecans, toasted, cooled and then crushed

methodSections.heading: Veggie Burgers
steps: In a large fry pan cook the onions, mushrooms, garlic, and herbs until the onions start to caramelize. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
Pulse the mixture with a food processor for 5-8 seconds, so it is chopped up, but not too fine.
In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients well.
Pan fry the patties till they are golden brown on each side and then place in an oven, preheated to 180°C (350°F), for 7 minutes.
Serve with all your favourite burger ingredients.
